case.title: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH. Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter. Need: 4580 pc a year. Category goal: stabilise a strategic supply: a healthy supplier and stable prices count, not only the lowest price. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 54 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200003. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for your renewal offer; the input increases you describe create genuine cost pressure. We value your consistently defect-free quality and recognise that group pricing controls constrain your discretion.

Your on-time delivery over the last four quarters was 84.6% (sc:70530@2026Q3). Our should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).

Our analysis supports an ambitious package built on annual demand visibility and a longer commitment, while delivery recovery remains a separate contractual obligation. We are flexible on payment terms; which option best fits your internal approval requirements?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 414.56 per unit, payment 30 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 415.73 per unit, payment 45 days net, 24-month agreement, 4,580 units per year.

We value our partnership and look forward to a dependable renewal with Selvbrunn.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.

We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length. We acknowledge your proposal for a 24-month agreement, which enables us to adjust our pricing. Regarding your inquiry on payment terms, 30 days net aligns best with our internal group requirements. Consequently, we offer a revised price of €429.36 per unit for this extended contract duration, and we have noted your remarks concerning delivery performance.

Our current offer stands at a price of €430.09 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €429.36 per unit, with a price of €429.36 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months.

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Birgit Mayrhofer,

Thank you for revising your offer in recognition of the longer agreement; we respect your group pricing constraints and preference for standard payment terms. We understand that the verified delivery record does not change your calculation, and delivery recovery remains a separate contractual obligation.

We have made a modest further move and are flexible on contract length: Option A retains the extended term you acknowledged, while our recommended Option B offers longer account continuity and demand visibility. Which duration works best for your internal approval process?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 423.18 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 45 days net, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 423.18 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 45 days net, 4,580 units per year.

We appreciate your constructive steps and feel we are close; we hope the longer commitment gives you room for a further commercial step toward agreement.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.body:

Thank you for recognising the planning value of a longer agreement; we acknowledge your pricing constraints and the payment condition on your alternative. Your request for supporting figures is fair, but our earlier estimate should not be treated as proof of excess profit.

We are taking a modest further step and ask for movement in return, while retaining extended payment terms rather than the standard payment period you requested. We are flexible on contract length: our recommended Option B supports longer capacity planning, so which duration works best for you?

We can offer either of these packages - please choose the one that suits you better:
Option A: EUR 425.82 per unit, 24-month agreement, payment 45 days net, 4,580 units per year.
Option B: EUR 425.82 per unit, 36-month agreement, payment 45 days net, 4,580 units per year.

We believe we are close and would appreciate your support in bringing this renewal to agreement on Option B.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
